attempts.raw_response: The trust now faces being placed into special measures, a move that would trigger intensive external support and monitoring. Baker added that while some staff were "caring and dedicated," the overall leadership had failed to drive necessary change. Patients, he warned, were being put at risk by delays in emergency departments and inconsistent care on wards. The CQC report highlighted serious issues with staffing levels, governance, and the management of patient safety incidents. The trust's chief executive acknowledged the findings, apologising to patients and promising an accelerated improvement plan. Local MPs have called for urgent government intervention, describing the situation as "unacceptable for a modern NHS service."

pair.human_continuation: "Many of these concerns had previously been identified at our inspection in 2018, yet necessary improvements had not been made," added Prof Baker. The CQC also called for improvements in the trust's board functions and clinical leadership, and for a more effective way to be found to act on recommendations. It wants risk assessments to be carried out for all A&E patients to identify those at risk of self-harm or suicide, and a better system to ensure "sufficient numbers" of staff. Hospital chairman Prof Steve Barnett has written an open letter to patients, vowing to "turn this organisation around". He said a new leadership team was being put in place, and that the trust had "a bright future ahead".
pair.prefix: Prof Ted Baker, the CQC's chief inspector of hospitals, said: "It was extremely concerning to find little evidence of improvement on our return to the Queen Elizabeth King's Lynn Hospital NHS Foundation Trust. "Improvements that needed to be made had not been made and the service fell short of what people should be able to expect." Inspectors found "significant concerns" within emergency services, medicine, end-of-life care and gynaecology.

source_document.title: King's Lynn Queen Elizabeth Hospital: 'Inadequate' trust still failing patients
